name: @lacspace/stockmedia
description: Search and download free-licence stock video clips and photos from the official Pexels and Pixabay APIs, normalized to one shape with licence + one-line attribution per asset. Pooled bring-your-own API keys, orientation/resolution/duration/safe-search filters, a heuristic news-safe flag, and per-query caching. Never scrapes news sites, social media or image search. Deterministic, isomorphic, zero third-party dependencies, bring-your-own-fetch.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
